m004: Full name: WPA Journal of Protocol, Diplomacy, Public Communication, Security & Communicology.
m006: Publisher: Sande Smiljanov, Editor-in-Chief. World Protocol Academy (WPA) is an independent digital educational, research and authorial platform in a development, testing and pilot phase.
m007: Mission: To be a specialised international academic and practitioner platform for state protocol, diplomacy, defence diplomacy, public communication, public relations, crisis communication, security studies, communicology, artificial intelligence and AI governance, ceremonial studies, institutional reputation and protocol education.
m008: State protocol · protocol of state institutions, state ceremonial, order of precedence, flag protocol.
m009: Diplomatic protocol · protocol of diplomatic meetings, treaty signing, accreditations, immunity.
m010: Diplomacy and international relations · theory and practice of diplomatic interaction.
m011: Defence diplomacy · defence diplomacy, military protocol, security coordination.
m012: Public communication and PR · institutional communication, reputation management.
m013: Crisis communication · protocol structure of crisis response.
m014: Communicology · scholarly studies of communication in an institutional context.
m015: Security and strategic studies · non-kinetic security, grey-zone, protocol-as-signal.
m016: Practitioner evidence · documented practice with signed consent.
m017: Artificial intelligence and AI governance · digital protocol, institutional AI applications, human control, provenance, synthetic media, AI agents, responsibility and AI governance. AI submissions must have a clear connection to the Journal's core domains; purely technical computer-science work without such a connection is outside scope.
m018: WPA Journal is committed to access without compromising integrity. No active submission, peer-review, editorial-decision, publication or production fee currently applies.
m019: Strict rules: No payment for acceptance. No payment for faster peer review. No payment for guaranteed publication. No hidden fees.
m020: Send the manuscript + submission form + required supporting documents to journal@worldprotocolacademy.mk.
m021: Editorial screening · format, length, relevance, AI declaration, conflict of interest, ethical consents. 7–14 days.
m022: Peer review · double-blind where possible (research articles, methodology notes); practitioner review for practitioner articles; editorial review for book reviews and teaching notes.
m023: Additional independent expert review · may be commissioned for flagship, methodological or sensitive manuscripts according to subject-matter competence.
m024: Reviewer and editor independence: reviewers with conflicts are excluded. When the Editor-in-Chief is an author or co-author, another qualified editor handles the manuscript and the Editor-in-Chief is fully recused from reviewer selection, review management, editorial discussion and the final decision.
m025: All articles that used AI assistance (drafting, translation, language editing, citation suggestion) must include an AI Transparency Note in the header. AI cannot be listed as a co-author. AI cannot fabricate citations. All AI-generated parts pass through human review.
m026: Correction for minor errors (typo, wrong date, wrong reference) — via a Correction Notice attached to the original article.
m027: Retraction for serious cases (fabricated citations, plagiarism, breach of consent, breach of ethics) — a Retraction Notice published together with the original article; the original remains clearly marked „RETRACTED”.
m028: Transparent status: WPA Journal is preparing its first issue and does not claim inclusion in Scopus, Web of Science or DOAJ, nor guaranteed discoverability in Google Scholar. ORCID is an author identifier and ResearchGate is a research/profile network — neither is a journal index. AD Scientific Index is not used as evidence of WPA Journal indexing status.
m029: e-ISSN · application via NUB after the complete first issue is fully prepared and online.
m030: DOI / Zenodo · only after publication and with a stable URL for each article; Crossref may be considered in a later phase.
m031: DOAJ · application intended once eligibility criteria are met.
m032: Scopus / Web of Science · under development — WPA will apply once eligibility criteria are met.
m033: Google Scholar · discoverability after publication is targeted but depends on crawler indexing; it is not claimed.
m034: Current: first-issue preparation, author invitations, public policies and Editorial Board formation with written consents.
m035: Editorial Board: names are listed publicly only after written acceptance, approved biography, COI declaration and Public Listing Consent.
m036: Manuscripts: editorial screening → independent/practitioner review → revisions → final editorial decision.
m037: Editorial Preview: the current flipbook is an unreviewed, unpublished editorial/design mock-up and should not be cited as a published issue.
m038: Final production: NUB workflow for UDC per article and COBISS.MK before production lock.
m039: Publication and identifiers: first the complete Issue 1 online; then the e-ISSN procedure; DOI only after publication with stable article URLs.
m040: Indexing: DOAJ / Scopus / Web of Science are considered only when relevant criteria are met.
m041: Future issues: publication frequency will stabilise according to real editorial capacity and completed review cycles.
m042: All dates are planned and forthcoming. WPA does not claim definitive deadlines until they are delivered.
m043: Submissions and general Journal enquiries: journal@worldprotocolacademy.mk. Integrity, COI and corrections: editor@worldprotocolacademy.mk.
m045: WPA Journal is actively preparing its first issue. The inaugural flipbook is an editorial/design preview only — it is not peer-reviewed, not published and should not be cited as a published issue.
m046: We do not claim ISSN or DOI until formally assigned. Indexing or discovery status is displayed only when factually confirmed.
m047: Fair Access: No active submission, peer-review, publication or production fee currently applies.
